messages.subject: Project Quartz - first draft licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

Please find attached the first draft of the Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement. It reflects the agreed term sheet: 4.5m upfront, 5.5m milestones, 6.5% royalty stepping to 4.0% above 80m cumulative net sales, 750k minimum annual royalty from year three, and a 125% liability cap. The Meridian research licence is carved out as a Permitted Encumbrance. We look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1212

Whitfield Carter LLP. Confidential and may be legally privileged.
